sections.basicsDesc: Essential details about your brand and industry

sections.audienceDesc: Who are you trying to reach and what drives them?
sections.namingDesc: Style, tone, and technical requirements for names

config.industryTooltip: Specify your business sector or market niche. This helps the AI understand your target audience and generate contextually appropriate brand names.
config.keywordsTooltip: Enter words or concepts that should inspire the brand name. These can be values (trust, innovation), attributes (fast, eco-friendly), or related terms (cloud, spark). The AI will use these to generate relevant name ideas.
config.toneTooltip: Select the personality and feel of your brand name. You can choose multiple tones to blend different characteristics, or add a custom tone.
config.charLengthTooltip: Choose preferred name lengths by character count. Short names are punchy, long names allow more detail.
config.wordCountTooltip: Choose how many words should be in the brand name. Single words are memorable, multiple words offer more meaning.
config.languageTooltip: Select the language for generated names. 'Both' will create a mix of English and Russian name suggestions.
config.customInstructionsPlaceholder: Any additional requirements for name generation...
config.customInstructionsTooltip: Add any specific requirements not covered above. E.g., 'avoid names starting with X', 'include nature themes', or 'must work as a domain name'.
config.targetAudiencePlaceholder: e.g., Tech-savvy millennials, Parents with young children...
config.targetAudienceTooltip: Describe your ideal customers: age group, gender, interests, lifestyle, values. This helps generate names that resonate with your audience.
config.positioningPlaceholder: e.g., Premium yet accessible, Disruptive innovator, Trusted expert...
config.positioningTooltip: How do you want your brand to be perceived? What makes you different from competitors? Define your unique position in the market.
config.competitorsPlaceholder: Enter competitor names separated by commas
config.competitorsTooltip: List your main competitors. AI will generate names that differentiate you while staying relevant to your industry.
config.inspirationBrandsPlaceholder: Enter brand names you admire, separated by commas
config.inspirationBrandsTooltip: List brands (from any industry) whose names you admire. This helps establish the style and feel you're aiming for.
config.restrictionsPlaceholder: e.g., Avoid religious terms, no names starting with 'X', must not sound similar to...
config.restrictionsTooltip: Specify what to avoid: certain letters, sounds, meanings, cultural associations, or anything else that's off-limits.
config.geographicMarketPlaceholder: e.g., Global, North America, Europe, Asia...
config.geographicMarketTooltip: Where will your brand operate? This affects pronunciation, cultural appropriateness, and domain availability considerations.
config.northStarPlaceholder: e.g., 'The most trusted partner for small business growth' or 'Making luxury accessible to everyone'
config.northStarTooltip: Your brand's core positioning in one sentence. This is the main anchor for all naming decisions - every name should express this essence.
config.oppositionSliderTooltip: How different should your name be from 80% of competitors? Low = safe and conventional, High = bold and oppositional.
config.nameCategoriesInfo: Select which types of names to generate. Each category has different strategic value.
config.companyStrategyTooltip: Your market positioning strategy affects the type of names that work best.
config.audienceWantsTooltip: What does your audience deeply desire? (2-3 values)
config.audienceFearsTooltip: What does your audience want to avoid? (2-3 fears)
config.communicationChannelsTooltip: How will customers encounter your brand name? This affects naming requirements.
config.abstractionLevelTooltip: What level should the name communicate at? Concrete product level or abstract mission level?
config.isCorporateTooltip: Enable for company names: prioritizes brevity, neutrality, and international appeal.
config.mktuClassesHint: Select trademark classes for your industry
config.mktuTooltip: Nice Classification (MKTU) defines product/service categories for trademark registration. Select classes relevant to your business for accurate trademark checking.
config.advancedOptionsDesc: Fine-tune character length, word count, creativity, and more
config.creativityTooltip: Controls how experimental the AI gets. Low = safer, more conventional names. High = more unique and unexpected suggestions.

associationWorkshop.title: Association Workshop
associationWorkshop.subtitle: Build creative associations to inspire unique names

step1.title: Step 1: Key Properties
step1.description: What are the 3-6 most important properties or attributes of your offering?
step1.hint: Add at least 3 properties to continue. These will be the foundation for your naming associations.
step1.methodologyDesc: Properties are the key characteristics that define your product or service. Think in three layers:
step1.functionalDesc: What does it do? (speed, reliability, efficiency)
step1.emotionalDesc: How does it make people feel? (confidence, joy, security)
step1.valuesDesc: What values does it represent? (innovation, sustainability, trust)

step2.title: Step 2: Build Associations
step2.description: For each property, add associated words by type: similarity, adjacency, or contrast
step2.hint: Add at least 3 associations across all properties to continue.
step2.similarityDesc: Direct analogies and metaphors from nature, technology, culture. What reminds you of this property?
step2.similarityExample: Fast → Lightning, Cheetah, Bullet, Falcon, Arrow
step2.adjacencyDesc: Concepts, actions, and contexts closely related to this property. What surrounds it?
step2.adjacencyExample: Fast → Efficiency, Momentum, Flow, Acceleration, Sprint
step2.contrastDesc: Opposite concepts that highlight the property by contrast. What does it overcome?
step2.contrastExample: Fast → Slow, Sluggish, Delayed, Heavy, Static

step3.title: Step 3: Cross & Create Seeds
step3.description: Select 2-3 associations to 'cross' and create naming seed ideas that will inspire AI generation
step3.placeholder: e.g., Lightning Flow, Velocity Mind, Swift Stream...
step3.hint: Seed ideas are optional but highly recommended - they guide the AI to generate more creative names.
step3.methodologyDesc: Crossing associations creates new semantic combinations that become naming seeds. This is where creativity meets strategy.
step3.technique1: Combine words from different properties (e.g., Fast + Reliable = SwiftGuard)
step3.technique2: Mix different association types (Similarity + Adjacency = CheetahFlow)
step3.technique3: Use contrasts creatively (Fast + opposite of Complex = VelocitySimple → Velosimple)
step3.technique4: Think of compound words, metaphors, or entirely new constructions
step3.exampleText: Properties: Fast + Intelligent → Associations: Lightning (fast/similarity) + Mind (intelligent/adjacency) → Seed: LightMind, MindBolt, Cerebro, Synapse
